description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and macros related to managing hooks in a version control system, including options for running hooks, finding hooks, and checking hook existence.

methods.name: find_hook
methods.description: Returns the path to the hook file or NULL if missing or disabled.

methods.name: hook_exists
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if a hook exists.

methods.name: run_hooks_opt
methods.description: Runs a specified hook with given options, freeing the options structure afterwards.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Wrapper for run_hooks_opt with default options.

methods.name: run_hooks_l
methods.description: Wrapper for run_hooks_opt that accepts additional arguments as list.
